column1: # Every legacy URL that must keep working, and where it goes.
#   1  url          the legacy path, exactly as it is served (trailing slash = directory)
#   2  target       what the emitted stub must navigate to
#   3  scope        both       -> a stub must exist AND _redirects must carry the same rule
#                   stub-only -> a stub must exist; _redirects must NOT need a rule
# `script/verify-build` asserts every row against a built _site/. Adding a redirect
# without adding it here means nothing checks it, which is how the inherited
# _redirects file drifted from the live Cloudflare rules in the first place.
# Derived on 2026-08-03 by diffing the legacy openmaptiles/www.openmaptiles.org
# routes against this build, and by reading the live 301 targets back off
# production (several off-site targets in the inherited _redirects were stale).
# No standalone page per layer any more (see the "schema" collection scope in
# _config.yml) — every row lands on the matching anchor on the combined page.
# --- off-site; also live as Cloudflare zone Redirect Rules --------------------
# --- pre-existing, emitted from the docs' own front matter --------------------
# These three carry redirect_from front matter from an earlier version of the site.
# All three 404 in production today; jekyll-redirect-from restores them.
# Deliberately absent from _redirects — the stubs work on every host.
